name: Agent Performance dashboard renders its empty state, and the agent editor's Stats tab is reachable
description: specs/16-agent-performance-dashboard.md. Seed deliberately fabricates no agent_runs (server/src/db/seed.ts: 'No run history is fabricated here'), so /agent-performance must show its real empty state, not invented zeros (AC-5) — and switching the range preset must not crash it. Also walks Agents → Security Reviewer → Stats tab: a regression check for a real bug found via manual QA on this feature, where AgentEditorView/constants.ts's VALID_TABS gate on ?tab= was never updated to include 'stats', so the tab button and the dashboard's own 'Open' link both silently fell back to the Config tab with no error. Asserting the Stats-only empty-state text (not just the URL, which updates either way) is what actually catches that class of bug. Read-only seeded data (no model call, no review run).

steps.label: AC-5: real empty state, not a fabricated zero-run table
still the honest empty state after a range switch, no crash
editor loads on the Config tab
switch to the agent's Stats tab
stats tab is active in the URL
regression check: Stats content actually renders (not a silent fallback to Config)
